content: Badiꞌa Ubugaubuga

Emeḡe Mamaꞌa eme zamare borofeꞌeteꞌe moneo zamaroꞌi. Aniꞌa emeḡe ufeta zamareꞌeteꞌe uꞌano, emeꞌe ane ubugaubuga rae hufadu emeꞌe ane ubugaubuga rae raꞌohe. Raha azaḡaniꞌa Badiꞌa mene ederiroteꞌe uꞌano eme mene edeḡa.

Eḡe zamarone azaḡa, izidi emeꞌe Badiꞌa ubugaubuga. Zama moneo emeꞌe nouge reiteꞌe ꞌize mene deheru edereꞌohe. Rehano eme edeḡa, Kerisoꞌa raha ꞌadao arine emeꞌe ani teigiꞌuma, mazaḡa eme aniꞌe iniu rae huga horoniꞌuma.
Iesuꞌa ariteꞌe horonoga guhineꞌeteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌaꞌe Kerisoꞌe deheḡa hune teige, ze zeḡeꞌa bare dehezeꞌohe.
Iniu haḡai sauꞌa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌaꞌe Badiꞌa goro ḡoeꞌa varadeꞌohe. Haḡai sauꞌaꞌe Badiꞌa goro ḡoeꞌa varadeꞌeteꞌe raꞌohe.
Za Iesuꞌa haḡai sauꞌa mae vaḡinifine raha ꞌadao furerarotaꞌaꞌe edeḡa. Ani mazao haḡai sauꞌaꞌe oꞌoꞌa.
Iniu ani teite tiburanadu radiuꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe haḡai sauꞌa mene ꞌaune haḡaeꞌohe. Iniu haḡai sauꞌa ꞌaune haḡaeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe Iesu mene horoniro zu mene ederiro.
Tahiꞌatahiꞌa, iniuꞌa za soꞌozoga gararoꞌi. Kerisoꞌe duduḡa teige, iniu haḡai duduḡa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa zuni Badiꞌa ubumao duduḡa.
Haḡai sauꞌa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe Diabolo mone vazeḡa, mazaḡa Diaboloꞌe ḡadaheḡanonoꞌo haḡai sauꞌa haḡae areꞌohe. Diabolo gauḡa ruinoga veize Badiꞌa Ubuganiꞌa ariro.

Badiꞌa ubugaubugaꞌe haḡai sauꞌa mene ꞌaune haḡaeꞌohe, mazaḡa Badiꞌaꞌa ḡabone iziga ezoneḡa zenadu ezone eꞌeꞌa zamazeo radiuꞌohe. Ze haḡai sauꞌa ꞌaune haḡaogaꞌe mene idaḡa, mazaḡa zeꞌe Badiꞌa ubugaubugano reiro.
Eꞌe uꞌano, eme iniuꞌe Badiꞌa ubugaubuga, ebu iniuꞌe Diabolo ubugaubuga rae deheru edereꞌohe. Iniu haḡai duduḡa mene haḡaeꞌeteꞌe zu negoḡa nabuga mene zamare borofeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe mene Badiꞌa ubuga.
Zamarotitoꞌi
Eme zamarotitiꞌuma. Aꞌe zaeꞌa ḡadaheḡanonoꞌo igiroteꞌe ḡoeꞌa.
Eme Kaino mene teigiꞌuma. Aniꞌe sauꞌa ḡauḡa, Satani mone vazeḡa radu ane negoḡa maro. Nougadu aniꞌa negoḡa maro? Mazaḡa ane haḡaiꞌe sauꞌa, u negoḡa haḡaiꞌe Badiꞌa ubumao duduḡa.
Nego nabudi, raha azaḡaniꞌa za heꞌeheꞌezoꞌidene, ago zaguzaganoꞌi.
Emeꞌa runeonoꞌo vaḡinadu ḡabone meirotaꞌaꞌe eme edeḡa, mazaḡa emeḡe nego nabudi zamare borofeꞌohe. Iniu negoḡa nabuga mene zamare borofeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe ruga.
Iniu ane negoḡa nabuga heꞌeheꞌezeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe vaze mauꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa. Zaꞌe edeḡa, vaze mauꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa mazao ḡabone tuḡutuḡuꞌe oꞌoꞌa.
Kerisoꞌa emeḡe veize ḡaboneḡa ahetiro. ꞌOugadu emeꞌa nougenouge vaze zamare borofeꞌetaꞌaꞌe ederiro. Eꞌanoꞌo eme zuni nego nabudi veize ḡabonefe ahetiꞌuma.
Raha toheḡa ḡehaḡa meiroteꞌe vazeḡaniꞌa negoḡa nabuga mazao ḡau ꞌahoga ferezeꞌeteꞌe horoneꞌe rehano, mene vetuḡazeadu mene danazine, aniꞌe Badiꞌa zamare borofeꞌohe rae reꞌumahe?
Tahiꞌatahiꞌa, eme hebe ga ḡoere hina daꞌo mene zamarotitiꞌuma, rehano haḡaife hina zu hugano zamarotitiꞌuma.
ꞌOugine, eme emeḡeꞌa ḡoere huga hegoteꞌetaꞌaꞌe ederiꞌuma, ebu Badiꞌa ubumao mene rihauꞌenaꞌa, zama roḡeḡano edaꞌuma.
Emeḡe zamaꞌa emeꞌe veꞌoḡa rae reine zuni, eme mene rihaꞌuma, mazaḡa Badiꞌaꞌe ḡihiꞌaḡa zu zamafe ufeta vitinoga. Aniꞌe ḡau niduꞌa edereꞌohe.
Eḡe zamarone azaḡa, emeḡe zamaꞌa emeꞌe veꞌoḡa rae mene reine, emeꞌe mene rihauꞌenaꞌa, Badiꞌa ubumao edaꞌuma.
Ebu emeꞌa nagini umideꞌeteꞌe ani mazaonoꞌo hidiꞌuma, mazaḡa ane goro ḡoeꞌa egohauꞌohe zu ani matuꞌohauꞌeteꞌe haḡaiḡa haḡaeꞌohe.
Ani goro ḡoeꞌaꞌe ꞌahi eꞌe: Ane Ubuga Iesu Keriso mazao fiꞌuma ebu aniꞌa ḡoere riḡa ifiroteꞌe teige, nego nabudi zamarotitiꞌuma.

Iniu Keriso goro ḡoeꞌa egohauꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe ani teite tiburanadu radiuꞌohe zu aniꞌe zeḡe teite tiburanadu radiuꞌohe. Kerisoꞌa emeḡe teite tiburanadu radiuꞌetaꞌaꞌe aniꞌa rifiroteꞌe Vineḡa Zaḡoḡa uꞌano edereꞌohe.
